headline: Gokul Agro Resources: Substantial Shareholder Disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: Kanubhai Jivatram Thakkar has filed a disclosure of substantial acquisition of shares in Gokul Agro Resources Limited under SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011. The filing marks a mandatory regulatory event in response to crossing share acquisition thresholds.
detail: The disclosure was submitted to the National Stock Exchange of India under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This mandatory filing arises when an acquirer crosses prescribed thresholds of shareholding (typically 25% or higher, or acquisition of 2% in a financial year once 25% is held). The specific consideration amount, number of shares acquired, and timing of acquisition are recorded in the filed disclosure document.
